title: ask_followup result
description: One shape whether the follow-up was delivered or refused. Follow-ups are capped at 2 per question and 6 per session; hitting a cap is delivered:false with a reason, never an exception.

turnId.description: Null when the follow-up was refused.

text.description: The question as actually put to the candidate. Echoed back so the model sees what it committed to.

followupCount.description: Follow-ups asked about parentQuestionId so far, including this one.

reason.description: Why delivery was refused. Null when delivered is true.
